description: Scaffold the React Native / Expo mobile application for PROWASH Phase 1. Creates the complete mobile directory structure with branding theme, reusable components, navigation shell, AuthContext, API service layer, and all auth screens (Splash, Welcome, Login, Register, ForgotPassword, ResetPassword) plus stub home screens for Customer and Admin. Depends on FEAT-001 being committed first so the API base URL is known, but the mobile app can be developed and bundled independently using the .env API_URL pointing at the backend.
steps: 1. Create mobile/package.json with name 'prowash-mobile', version '1.0.0', main 'App.js'. Dependencies: expo (~51.0.0), react, react-native, @react-navigation/native, @react-navigation/native-stack, @react-navigation/bottom-tabs, expo-status-bar, expo-secure-store, expo-constants, expo-image-picker, expo-font, @expo/vector-icons, axios, @react-native-async-storage/async-storage, react-native-safe-area-context, react-native-screens, react-native-gesture-handler, react-native-reanimated, react-hook-form. devDependencies: babel-preset-expo.

2. Create mobile/app.json with expo config: name 'PROWASH', slug 'prowash', version '1.0.0', orientation portrait, icon './src/assets/icon.png' (placeholder path), splash { image './src/assets/splash.png', resizeMode 'contain', backgroundColor '#0B1B2B' }, android { adaptiveIcon { backgroundColor '#0B1B2B' } }, ios { supportsTablet false }, scheme 'prowash' (for deep links in password reset).
3. Create mobile/babel.config.js exporting { presets: ['babel-preset-expo'] }.
4. Create mobile/.env.example with API_URL=http://localhost:5000/api. Create mobile/.env as a copy with the same value.
5. Create mobile/src/assets/ directory placeholder (place a README.md stub inside noting that icon.png and splash.png should be added before publishing).

6. Create mobile/src/theme/colors.js — export default object with: midnight:'#0B1B2B', ocean:'#147DAB', aqua:'#40C4FF', cloud:'#F4F7FA', softGray:'#E8EEF3', success:'#2E7D32', warning:'#F57F17', error:'#C62828', white:'#FFFFFF', black:'#000000', textPrimary:'#0B1B2B', textSecondary:'#5C6B7A', textLight:'#FFFFFF', cardBg:'#FFFFFF', inputBg:'#F4F7FA', border:'#E8EEF3', dark:{ background:'#0B1B2B', card:'#112236', inputBg:'#1C2E40', textPrimary:'#F4F7FA', textSecondary:'#9DB4C8', border:'#1C2E40' }.
7. Create mobile/src/theme/spacing.js — export default { xs:4, sm:8, md:16, lg:24, xl:32, xxl:48, borderRadius:{ sm:8, md:12, lg:20, xl:30, full:999 } }.

8. Create mobile/src/theme/typography.js — export default with fontSizes (xs:11,sm:13,md:15,lg:17,xl:20,xxl:24,xxxl:30,display:36), fontWeights (regular:'400',medium:'500',semibold:'600',bold:'700',extrabold:'800'), lineHeights and a helper makeTextStyle(size,weight,color) function.

9. Create mobile/src/constants/index.js — exports: APP_NAME='PROWASH', TAGLINE='Premium Vehicle Cleaning & Care', ROLES={ CUSTOMER:'customer', ADMIN:'admin' }, BOOKING_STATUS object, PAYMENT_METHODS object, VEHICLE_TYPES array. Also export API_BASE_URL reading from expo-constants expoConfig.extra or falling back to 'http://localhost:5000/api'.

10. Create mobile/src/utils/storage.js — exports saveToken(token), getToken(), removeToken() using expo-secure-store; exports savePreference(key,value), getPreference(key), removePreference(key) using AsyncStorage for non-sensitive data.

11. Create mobile/src/utils/validation.js — exports pure functions: isValidEmail(email), isValidPhone(phone), isStrongPassword(pw) (min 8 chars, 1 upper, 1 digit), isRequired(val), and a validateRegisterForm(data) that returns { valid:bool, errors:{field:message} }.

12. Create mobile/src/services/api.js — creates and exports an axios instance with baseURL from constants/index.js API_BASE_URL. Adds a request interceptor that reads the token via storage.getToken() and sets Authorization header. Adds a response interceptor that on 401 clears the token (logout side-effect via a callback registered with setLogoutCallback). Export setLogoutCallback(fn) so AuthContext can wire itself up.

13. Create mobile/src/services/authService.js — exports: register(data) → POST /auth/register, login(email,password) → POST /auth/login, getMe() → GET /auth/me, forgotPassword(email) → POST /auth/forgot-password, resetPassword(token,password) → POST /auth/reset-password/:token. All return response.data.

14. Create mobile/src/context/AuthContext.js — React context + provider. State: user, token, loading. On mount: reads token from SecureStore, calls getMe() to validate, sets user or clears token if 401. Exposes: login(email,password) → calls authService.login, saves token, sets user; logout() → clears token, nulls user; register(data) → calls authService.register, saves token, sets user. Registers the 401 logout callback with api.setLogoutCallback. Export useAuth hook and AuthProvider.
15. Create mobile/src/hooks/useAuth.js — re-exports useAuth from AuthContext (convenience re-export so screens can import from hooks/).

16. Create mobile/src/components/AppButton.js — RN TouchableOpacity-based button accepting props: title, onPress, variant ('primary'|'secondary'|'outline'|'ghost'), size ('sm'|'md'|'lg'), loading (bool), disabled (bool), style, textStyle. Uses theme colors. Shows ActivityIndicator when loading.

17. Create mobile/src/components/AppInput.js — RN TextInput wrapper accepting: label, value, onChangeText, placeholder, error (string), secureTextEntry, keyboardType, leftIcon, rightIcon, multiline, style. Shows label above, error message below. Keyboard-aware. Uses theme.

18. Create mobile/src/components/AppHeader.js — header component accepting: title, subtitle, showBack (bool), onBack, rightAction (node). Uses SafeAreaView top inset. Uses theme midnight background with white text.
19. Create mobile/src/components/LoadingView.js — full-screen centered ActivityIndicator + optional message prop. Uses theme colors.
20. Create mobile/src/components/ErrorView.js — full-screen error display with icon, message prop, and optional onRetry callback button.
21. Create mobile/src/components/EmptyState.js — centered empty state with icon name prop (@expo/vector-icons Ionicons), title, subtitle, and optional action button.

22. Create mobile/src/components/StatusBadge.js — small pill badge accepting status string. Maps status → color from theme (pending→warning, confirmed→ocean, completed→success, cancelled→error, etc.). Renders colored background + white text.
23. Create mobile/src/components/ConfirmDialog.js — Modal-based confirmation dialog accepting: visible, title, message, confirmText, cancelText, onConfirm, onCancel, destructive (bool). Uses theme.

24. Create mobile/src/screens/auth/SplashScreen.js — full-screen branded screen with midnight navy background, PROWASH text logo (large bold white text), tagline, and an animated fade-in. On mount, reads token and calls getMe(); navigates to CustomerHome, AdminHome, or Welcome depending on result. Shows ActivityIndicator during check.

25. Create mobile/src/screens/auth/WelcomeScreen.js — branded welcome screen with ocean/aqua gradient simulation (multiple View layers), PROWASH logo area, tagline, feature bullet points (Clean • Fast • Reliable), two CTAs: 'Get Started' (→ Register) and 'Sign In' (→ Login). Lottie or simple animated icon optional — keep it pure RN if Lottie not available.

26. Create mobile/src/screens/auth/LoginScreen.js — keyboard-aware scroll view, logo header, email + password inputs using AppInput, 'Forgot Password?' link, 'Sign In' AppButton (loading state while API call runs), error message display, 'Create account' link to Register. On success navigates based on role to CustomerHome or AdminHome.

27. Create mobile/src/screens/auth/RegisterScreen.js — full name, email, phone, password, confirm password fields using AppInput + react-hook-form validation. 'Create Account' AppButton with loading. Error display. Link back to Login. On success navigates to CustomerHome.
28. Create mobile/src/screens/auth/ForgotPasswordScreen.js — email input, 'Send Reset Link' button, success message display ('Check your inbox'), back to Login link.

29. Create mobile/src/screens/auth/ResetPasswordScreen.js — reads token from route params (deep link: prowash://reset-password/:token). New password + confirm password inputs, 'Reset Password' button, navigates to Login on success.

30. Create mobile/src/screens/customer/CustomerHomeScreen.js — stub screen with AppHeader showing 'Welcome, {user.name}', a greeting card, placeholder sections ('Your Vehicles', 'Recent Bookings', 'Services'), and a logout button in the header. Full implementation is Phase 2.

31. Create mobile/src/screens/admin/AdminHomeScreen.js — stub screen with AppHeader showing 'Admin Dashboard', stat cards (Bookings Today, Pending, Revenue — all showing '--'), and a logout button. Full implementation is Phase 2.

32. Create mobile/src/navigation/AuthNavigator.js — createNativeStackNavigator with screens: Welcome (WelcomeScreen), Login (LoginScreen), Register (RegisterScreen), ForgotPassword (ForgotPasswordScreen), ResetPassword (ResetPasswordScreen). All screens have headerShown:false.

33. Create mobile/src/navigation/CustomerNavigator.js — stub createBottomTabNavigator with one tab: Home (CustomerHomeScreen). Tab bar uses ocean theme. Further tabs (Services, Bookings, Profile) added in Phase 2.
34. Create mobile/src/navigation/AdminNavigator.js — stub createNativeStackNavigator with one screen: AdminHome (AdminHomeScreen). Further admin screens added in Phase 2.

35. Create mobile/src/navigation/RootNavigator.js — reads { user, loading } from useAuth. If loading → renders LoadingView. If user.role==='admin' → renders AdminNavigator. If user → renders CustomerNavigator. Else → renders AuthNavigator. Wrapped in NavigationContainer with linking config for deep link scheme 'prowash'.

36. Create mobile/App.js — imports AuthProvider from context/AuthContext, RootNavigator from navigation/RootNavigator, SafeAreaProvider from react-native-safe-area-context, GestureHandlerRootView. Renders GestureHandlerRootView > SafeAreaProvider > AuthProvider > RootNavigator.
37. Run cd mobile && npm install. Confirm exit 0. Then run npx expo export --platform android to confirm the bundle compiles without errors. Fix any import errors or missing dependencies found.
acceptance_criteria: cd mobile && npm install exits with code 0
npx expo export --platform android (or npx expo start --no-dev) exits without JavaScript bundler errors
App.js renders without crashing — NavigationContainer, AuthProvider, and RootNavigator mount correctly
SplashScreen navigates to WelcomeScreen when no token is stored
LoginScreen submits to POST /api/auth/login and stores the returned JWT in SecureStore
LoginScreen navigates customer users to CustomerNavigator and admin users to AdminNavigator after successful login
RegisterScreen submits to POST /api/auth/register and navigates to CustomerHomeScreen on success
ForgotPasswordScreen calls POST /api/auth/forgot-password and shows success message
All shared components (AppButton, AppInput, AppHeader, LoadingView, ErrorView, EmptyState, StatusBadge, ConfirmDialog) render without errors
Theme exports (colors, spacing, typography) are importable from any screen
verification: cd c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\PROWASH\mobile && npx expo export --platform android
findings: Bundle compiles successfully (npx expo export --platform android exits 0, 1116 modules). Three issues resolved during implementation: (1) react-native-gesture-handler, react-native-screens, react-native-safe-area-context, and react-native-reanimated all ship 'react-native': 'src/index.ts(x)' in their package.json but omit the TS source from the npm tarball; added metro.config.js with a custom resolveRequest that redirects these four packages to their precompiled lib/ builds. (2) react-native-gesture-handler lib/commonjs build requires lodash/isEqual as an undeclared peer dep; installed lodash and added it to package.json dependencies. (3) Global expo-cli was installed on the machine; used local node_modules/.bin/expo for all CLI commands to avoid SDK version mismatch.
